data.long_meaning: Bharika is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'bhar' which means to bear or carry. The name signifies one who brings prosperity and success. In Hindu mythology, Bharat, an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, is also known as Bharika. Bharika is a name of strength and prosperity. The name Bharika carries the meaning “Bringer of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bharika usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
